parsed.review_summary: The candidate edit correctly addresses all four error targets. It fixes the evidence misread by distinguishing between simulation studies and experimental validation on real datasets, noting that the comment only offers a possibility. It corrects the rubric misapplication by acknowledging that the action is explicit but vague on execution. It removes the factual error about authors being able to directly apply the action. It also corrects the score mapping by avoiding any explicit numeric score or gold label, instead describing the comment as an explicit action with vague execution, which naturally maps to the appropriate rubric band. Unrelated correct reasoning is preserved, and no new evidence is invented.
